philippines.title: Search continues for missing Benguet resident
philippines.description:
BAGUIO CITY — Search and rescue operations are underway for a man who has been missing since Sept. 3 in Barangay Sagubo, Kapangan, Benguet. The missing man was identified as Raul Aludos Juan, a resident of the barangay. His disappearance was reported to the Kapangan Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO) around noon on Sept. 5. Barangay officials and local volunteers immediately conducted an initial search but failed to locate Juan by evening. philippines.title: Laoag boosts barangay emergency response with new vehicles
philippines.description:
SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — The city government of Laoag in Ilocos Norte has begun distributing the first batch of multipurpose vehicles to the city’s 80 barangays to strengthen their capacity to respond to emergencies and other community needs. The city government announced this on Monday, Sept. 7, noting that the vehicles were funded by the city government through the initiative of Mayor James Bryan Alcid. Each multipurpose vehicle is equipped with a stretcher, oxygen tank, first-aid kit, blood pressure apparatus, ladder, and chainsaw, among other equipment needed during emergencies.
